title: Using Stock Images: Photos by Pexels, Pixabay, Stock Icons and Giphy
text:
## Using Stock Images: Photos by Pexels, Pixabay, Stock Icons and Giphy
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000096277
Searching for royalty-free images is available through the Media Manager's stock library.
Open My Content > Media Manager and click Stock Library .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12182911482/original/e2xFS-5P8SMi9qHfMQzLPkbYweFrjcbDbQ.png?1785488595 | alt: ]

## Image Selection
Type in the keyword to search, select the Orientation (square, vertical, horizontal), choose from the dropdown the source (Pixabay, Pexels or Giphy) and click on " Search Photos ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171319786/original/XBqsLu_7zZ4KJoW0rBHTnu-EadqvkEie8Q.png?1764641740 | alt: ]
IMPORTANT: The Icon Library is available only in the admin section.
Select the size and click the download button to add the image to the Media Manager.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132677186/original/M63xL6vmwGPE2Iw16OkuY3u78xM6elFSsA.jpg?1697135555 | alt: ]
The image will now be available in the Media Manager:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134919568/original/fd_AL6QlNmlbJ6A1JZs0gfguTDZv5poCUg.png?1700856053 | alt: ]

## Icon Library
When selecting an icon from the Icon Library, a color can also be chosen so the icon matches the site's colors. After a color is selected, each icon previews in the color it will be downloaded as.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12156575762/original/nU74LOKKthPIX6dSwfGorPmv8MmqmlR2VA.png?1738863270 | alt: ]
